title: A new outbound destination is permitted
context: Production casework, UK, assisted autonomy with human review

change.description: A partner API is added to the egress allowlist.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: Network access is no longer constrained to the destinations the containment test covered (C-15). The new destination is a third party, so the approved processing and residency terms no longer describe where customer data can go (C-10).
